title: The Bread Robot
summary: A little robot burns its first loaf, then bakes one that makes the whole street cheer.

panels.scene: Bolt stares at a smoking black loaf in a tiny kitchen
Mama Rosa smiles and hands over a wooden spoon

dialogue.speaker: Mama Rosa
dialogue.text: Every baker starts with burnt bread.

panels.scene: Bolt kneads dough, flour flying everywhere
Neighbours cheer around a golden loaf

title: Sunny the Puddle Jumper
summary: After the rain, a girl and her dog turn every puddle into a stepping stone to adventure.

panels.scene: Rain stops, Mia peeks out the window
Mia and Pip leap over a huge puddle
A rainbow appears over the playground

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.text: We found the end of it!

panels.scene: Both lie in the grass laughing

title: The Last Lantern
summary: A lamp-lighter loses his old friend, but learns his light still guides others home.

panels.scene: Oren sits alone beside an unlit lantern at dusk

dialogue.speaker: Oren
dialogue.text: He used to light this one with me.

panels.scene: Tali sits down quietly beside him

dialogue.speaker: Tali
dialogue.text: Can I help you light it?

panels.scene: The lantern glows over a foggy street
Villagers walk home along the lit road

title: Goodbye, Little Cloud
summary: A cloud must rain itself away to save a dry village, and says farewell to the sun.

panels.scene: Nimbo floats over a cracked, dry field
Sun looks worried from the sky
Rain falls, Nimbo grows smaller
Green sprouts grow beneath a tiny rainbow

title: The Stolen Crown
summary: A furious young knight chases a thief, and learns anger is best spent on fixing things.

panels.scene: Dara slams her fist on an empty throne cushion
Dara storms through a dark forest
Fox is cornered, holding a cracked crown

dialogue.speaker: Fox
dialogue.text: I only wanted to fix it!

panels.scene: Dara kneels and mends the crown with Fox

title: Thunder in the Kitchen
summary: A grumpy storm spirit ruins a picnic, then finds out shouting is lonelier than listening.

panels.scene: Rumble thunders over a ruined picnic
Ben holds an umbrella, calm
Rumble shrinks to a small grey cloud
Both share a sandwich under the umbrella

title: The Door in the Attic
summary: Two siblings find a glowing attic door and discover the monster behind it is just afraid too.

panels.scene: A glowing door creaks in a dusty attic
A huge shadow looms behind the door
A small furry monster trembles in the corner
The siblings share a flashlight with the monster

dialogue.speaker: Kai
dialogue.text: We were scared of you too.

title: Night Walk Home
summary: A boy walks home in the dark, and the 'ghost' following him turns out to be a lost kitten.

panels.scene: Sam walks a dark street, streetlights flickering
Pale eyes glow in the bushes behind him
Sam spins round with a stick raised
Sam carries the kitten home, smiling

title: The Egg That Hummed
summary: A farmer finds a humming egg in the barn, and out hatches a tiny dragon with hiccups.

panels.scene: Farmer Joy lifts a glowing egg from the hay

dialogue.speaker: Farmer Joy
dialogue.text: This is not a chicken egg.

panels.scene: The egg cracks open with a flash
A baby dragon hiccups tiny flames
The dragon warms the farmhouse toast

title: The Gift With No Name
summary: A girl opens a mystery box on her birthday and finds a key to a secret garden.

panels.scene: Noor shakes a plain brown box at her party
Inside lies a glittering old key
Grandpa points at a hidden gate behind the roses
The gate opens on a garden full of lanterns
